description: Update a database record. By default the given fields are shallow-merged into the existing record; set merge=false to replace it entirely. The record's id always stays fixed to match its array position.

data.description: Fields to set (or the complete record when merge=false)

merge.description: Merge into existing record (true) or replace (false)

type.description: Which database to access (e.g. actors, items, skills, troops, commonEvents)

name: update_record
title: Update database record
